messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

message.content:
Here’s a list of the long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023 (dates that fall on a Friday or Monday, creating a three‑day weekend). Note that some holidays are observed on the nearest weekday if they fall on a weekend.

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Observed (if applicable) |
|---------|-------------|---------------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 (Sunday) | Observed Jan 2 (Monday) |
| Family Day (BC, AB, SK, NB) | Feb 20 (Monday) | — |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 (Friday) | — |
| Easter Monday (Federal employees) | Apr 10 (Monday) | — |
| Victoria Day | May 22 (Monday) | — |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 (Saturday) | Observed Jul 3 (Monday) |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 (Monday) | — |
| Thanksgiving (Canada) | Oct 9 (Monday) | — |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 (Monday) | — |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 (Monday) | — |
| Boxing Day | Dec 26 (Tuesday) | — |

These are the federal public holidays that create long weekends in 2023. Provincial holidays may add additional long weekends (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario, St. John’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, etc.).
